claims: Walmart stores will be open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Most Walmart stores will operate under regular hours on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Walmart stores' regular hours are typically from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.
Target will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Costco will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Sam's Club will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Many Easter items will be marked down 50-90% starting Monday, April 6, 2026.
